title: The repo contract detects unittest, phpunit and workspace layouts, or adopt names the gap
body:
Why: PP:46, PP:66
Outcome: `krn repo contract` returns test and related for unittest, phpunit, nested go.mod/Cargo.toml, pnpm workspace; an undetected stack prints the fields to write
Proof: `node --test test/repo/contract.test.ts` on generated fixtures. Also `npm run fast` PASS.
Size: 1 PR
After (plan): t-bmt0xgz
Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan.md section 2 (plan id N03).

Lead rework (CI run 43498935222 red): test/portability/fixtures.test.ts 2 of 9 fail: expected /skipped krn\.json \(no test command detected/ but adopt now writes krn.json; the widened src/repo/contract.ts detection finds a test command in fixtures meant to have none (check fixtures 1 python pyproject+pytest and 7). Decide per fixture: if the new detection is right, update the fixture expectation and say why in the commit; if wrong (e.g. composer/go.mod/Cargo one-level-down without tests), narrow detection. Run node --test test/portability/fixtures.test.ts locally before shipping.
